class Bank:
    def __init__(self): self.bal={}
    def open(self,n,a=0): self.bal[n]=a
    def transfer(self,s,d,amt):
        if s==d: return True
        if amt<0: return False
        if self.bal.get(s,0)-amt<0: return False
        self.bal[s]=self.bal.get(s,0)-amt
        self.bal[d]=self.bal.get(d,0)+amt
        return True
